The whole video on one line

Timeline, drawn to scale

The hook is finished before 3 seconds. The two hatched boxes are where Sridhar's real screen recordings play. Yellow marks the only things that change from one builder to the next.

Scene by scene

Four scenes, with the exact words

Each picture is a real frame of the working preview, video_animatic.html. The Hindi lines are a draft and need a native check by Sridhar before they are recorded.

1

The question

0.0 to 3.0 s

On screen

  • Finished on the very first frame: a Hindi question at 68 px, the English line under it at 42 px, an indent card with an Approve? stamp.
  • Top chip: Nexus360, ERP + CRM for builders. The per-builder version shows the name chip here instead.
  • Bottom: logo and Sridhar Patnaik. No job title until he confirms it. No logo card before the question.

Voice-over (Sridhar, Hindi)

साइट से इंडेंट आया है। अप्रूव करने से पहले आप क्या देखते हैं?

Site se indent aaya hai. Approve karne se pehle aap kya dekhte hain?

English cut: An indent came in from site. What do you check before you approve it?

Slot and what we need

  • Logo file from Sridhar.
  • No screen recording in this scene.
  • Per-builder slot: [Project name] and [City] in the chip.

Why this scene

A situation the viewer has lived, in the language the office speaks, with the question visible from frame 0 and the whole hook done within 3 seconds. Our campaign 1 video opened with a logo card before any message.

2

Screen A: checks before approval

3.0 to 9.2 s

On screen

  • A phone frame holds the real recording. Above it: the tag SCREEN A, and Hindi plus English: Checked before you approve.
  • Under it, one caption at a time, about 1.3 s each: 1 Stock at site, 2 Unused stock at other sites, 3 Material already on order, 4 BOQ limit. Dots show progress.
  • Every text on the stage is 28 px or larger, which is about 15 px on a 390 px phone.

Voice-over (Sridhar, Hindi)

अप्रूव से पहले Nexus360 देखता है: साइट का स्टॉक, दूसरी साइटों पर पड़ा स्टॉक, ऑर्डर पर माल, BOQ की सीमा।

Approve se pehle Nexus360 dekhta hai: site ka stock, doosri saiton par pada stock, order par maal, BOQ ki seema.

English cut: Before you approve, Nexus360 checks site stock, unused stock at other sites, material on order, and the BOQ limit.

Slot and what we need

  • Recording A from Sridhar: the indent approval screen with its checks visible, 6 to 8 seconds, sample data only.
  • We zoom into the check panel so the numbers on his screen are readable on a phone.
  • The captions are reordered to match what the recording shows. We never caption something the recording does not show.

Why this scene

This is the proof. Nexus360's own site lists these checks as part of indent approval (and one more, similar recent indents, which the video leaves out for length). A real screen is more believable than an animation of a screen.

3

Screen B: customers in the same system

9.2 to 13.2 s

On screen

  • Same frame as scene 2 so the eye does not have to learn a new layout. Tag: SCREEN B. Hindi plus English: Customers in the same system.
  • Three captions, about 1 s each: Leads and follow-ups, Site visits, Payments against the schedule.

Voice-over (Sridhar, Hindi)

ग्राहक, फॉलो-अप, साइट विज़िट और पेमेंट भी इसी सिस्टम में।

Grahak, follow-up, site visit aur payment bhi isi system mein.

English cut: Leads, follow-ups, site visits and payments are in the same system.

Slot and what we need

  • Recording B from Sridhar: a lead, then a follow-up or site visit in the planner, then a customer payment schedule. 5 to 6 seconds, sample data only.
  • If his existing CRM and ERP demo videos can be reused, we cut both recordings from them.

Why this scene

The second problem a builder lives with: customer follow-ups and collections. It is one scene, so the video stays under 20 seconds.

4

The ask

13.2 to 17.0 s

On screen

  • A photo of Sridhar, his name, Nexus360, and his +91 number as plain readable text. No job title until he confirms it.
  • Hindi plus English: Book a demo on WhatsApp.
  • One plain line says what the tap does: Tap Book a demo. Nothing is sent until you press Send.
  • No button shape inside the video, so nobody tries to tap the video itself.

Voice-over (Sridhar, Hindi)

डेमो के लिए WhatsApp पर मुझे लिखिए। मैं श्रीधर, Nexus360 से।

Demo ke liye WhatsApp par mujhe likhiye. Main Sridhar, Nexus360 se.

English cut: To see a demo, message me on WhatsApp. I'm Sridhar, from Nexus360.

Slot and what we need

  • Photo and WhatsApp number from Sridhar.
  • Per-builder slot: a small chip, For [Project name], [City].

Why this scene

A named human with a number and a one-tap action that costs nothing to try. The person who answers is the person in the frame.

Personalisation

What changes for each builder

Only a name chip on the first and last scene. The voice, the two recordings and every product statement stay the same for everyone.

How a version is made

  • Your two recordings are cut into numbered frames once, and the same page that draws the preview plays them.
  • Each version is drawn frame by frame by the renderer we already use for our own videos, then joined with the voice.
  • Before you see a render we check: text size, the hook on frame 0, no price, no savings claim, no word we have banned, and that every caption appears in your recording.
  • Nothing is sent to a builder until you approve the video and the page.

Not in the video, on purpose

  • No savings, ROI or time-saved figure. The Nexus360 site makes none, so we make none.
  • No customer name or logo without written permission.
  • No other state, no other builder's results, no price.
  • No fake product screen shown as real: until your recordings arrive, the boxes say PLACEHOLDER.

Prepared by IV Infotech for Nexus360. The stills on this sheet come from a preview with placeholder boxes. Nothing here has been sent to any builder.
